correctness.rationale: For every finite graph, inclusion-exclusion counts all 2-faces, and an explicit forest-rooted acyclic matching gives critical counts 1, binom(c-1,2), and s-binom(n-1,2)+binom(c-1,2). The root-component graph retraction identifies the fundamental group and the critical one-skeleton free basis; hence all 2-cell attaching maps are nullhomotopic, proving the integral wedge result. Independent exact exhaustive checks for 33,866 graphs on 2–6 vertices and complete acyclicity on 2–5 vertices support implementation; finite checks do not replace infinite proof.
